description: `__exit__` returning a true value: the exception is discarded and execution resumes after the `with` statement.
Standard manager that swallows the listed exception types and their subclasses; since 3.12 it also filters exception groups.
A reusable suppressing manager that keeps the matching exception objects so a batch can report every failure.
`KeyboardInterrupt`, `SystemExit`, `GeneratorExit`, `asyncio.CancelledError`: control-flow signals that broad handlers must let through.
`except:` catches everything, including `BaseException` subclasses; it is the Python spelling of an untyped JavaScript `catch`.
